text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket! Do not crush the heels of 
your shoes. Have some decency!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ah, I just finished up training, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even so. You surely have enough leeway to 
put your shoes on properly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Shoes exist to protect your legs. 
Neglecting them will only lead to injury. 
Our legs are our very life as horse
girls, 
are they not?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, my bad! I fixed 'em, so get 
off my back already.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wait, we are not finished discussing your 
mindset. To begin with, you constantly 
wear your uniform so slovenly,
and that as 
well—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!! Quit being so damn persistent! I 
already told you I got it!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ah, no... well. ...My bad.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
............In my previous conduct... 
which point felt "persistent" to you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I want you to tell me specifically what 
triggered the emotion that made you 
irritated enough to raise your voice. At 
which words did you feel it? Or was it my 
facial expression?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wh-... What the hell's wrong with you?! 
Give me a break!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait! Explain it in detail!

One day,
while walking across the plaza, a 
horse girl came charging toward me amidst 
a loud commotion.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —tch! Th-That was close...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Pokke, give up and 
explain!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Forgive me. I lost my composure for a 
moment. The truth is—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I heard from Mother.
You have been playing 
games and staying up late, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Groove's Younger Sis...
text_block_list.text: "That was only once..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Listen to me. I am not telling you not to 
play games. I am telling you to exercise 
moderation. This applies to everything in 
life.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I know, why not make a daily schedule? 
Decide your leisure hours in advance.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You have always had a tendency to rush 
forward recklessly. Making a schedule 
should prove effective. Let's see. 
Starting around next month—

text_block_list.name: Groove's Younger Sis...
text_block_list.text: "Jeez! Big Sis, you're so persistent!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...And so, that brings us to this. I 
wanted to understand what part of my 
behavior my younger sister found so 
persistent as to make her angry.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I see—well,
I can totally relate. I've got 
a nagging older bro at home too, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Just lying down in the living room gets
me 
yelled at for being sloppy and slacking 
off, and on top of that he goes and makes 
schedules for me without asking.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: It's so damn nitpicky, it drives me nuts.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
But hey,
I know you're only tellin' me all 
that 'cause ya care about me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I mean, naggin' someone that much means 
you're really lookin' out for 'em and 
watchin' closely!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So don't sweat it, you're fine! Quit 
worryin' so damn much!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That may be true... ...However,
this is on 
a case-by-case basis.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I must gather more data to raise
precision 
and pinpoint the exact root of my
sister's 
grievance. —Your input was helpful, both 
of you. You have my thanks.
